description: This file defines an API class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module, specifically handling the action of marking a candidate interview as passed. It includes validation rules, API endpoint documentation, and method to get the state transition.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI
classes.description: API class for marking a candidate's interview as passed within the recruitment process. Extends AbstractCandidateActionAPI and defines validation rules, API documentation annotations, and workflow state transition method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating an interview pass status, adding validation for the interview ID parameter.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state representing the 'pass' action for a candidate's interview, used to update the candidate's application status.
